data.text: Unity is a popular and well-known programming environment for developers who wish to work with extended reality systems. The platform comprises a three-dimensional game engine and a developer interface that provides support for the computer graphics pipeline, allowing a developer to focus on building the immersive experience. It is a cross-platform game engine that supports both two-dimensional and three-dimensional content on over 20 different platforms.
points: Unity is a popular programming environment for developers who wish to work with extended reality systems.
The Unity platform comprises a three-dimensional game engine and a developer interface.
Unity provides support for the computer graphics pipeline so a developer can focus on building the immersive experience.
Unity is a cross-platform engine that supports 2D and 3D content on over 20 different platforms.

data.text: Unity Hub is a standalone application for installing and managing the Unity Editor and Game Engine. The Unity Game Engine is a middleware for building and deploying XR systems, and the Unity Editor allows for building immersive environments without having to master the computer graphics pipeline. Unity Hub manages multiple versions of Unity in one place and can manually add existing installations, but it is not mandatory.
points: Unity Hub is a standalone application for installing and managing the Unity Editor and Game Engine.
The Unity Game Engine is a middleware for building and deploying XR systems.
The Unity Editor allows for building immersive environments without having to master the computer graphics pipeline.
Unity Hub manages multiple versions of Unity in one place and can manually add existing installations, but it is not mandatory.

data.text: The preference tab lets developers select settings for virtual, mixed, and augmented reality. The Unity editor interface includes several windows, such as the scene view for interacting with game objects and the game view for previewing the final application.
points: The preference tab lets developers select settings for virtual, mixed, and augmented reality.
The Unity editor interface includes several windows and bars.
The scene view is an interactive view used to select and modify game objects while building a scene.
The game view renders a preview of the final application from a camera.

data.text: Unity assets are items used to create applications and can be imported from outside or created internally. A scene is a specific type of asset containing parts of an application that can be edited through a scene interface. Game objects act as containers for components to define functionality, while prefabs serve as templates to make instances of those objects in a scene.
points: Unity assets are items used to create applications and can be imported from outside or created internally.
A scene is a specific type of asset containing parts of an application that can be edited through a scene interface.
Game objects are fundamental objects that act as containers for components to define their functionality.
Prefabs are templates of game objects used to create instances in a Unity scene.
